input:
Write a bash script that renders a config template.

Starting files:
--- /home/eval/app/app.conf.tmpl ---
# generated for ${APP_ENV}
[db]
host = ${DB_HOST}
port = ${DB_PORT}
url = postgres://${DB_USER}@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/app
[runtime]
home = ${RUNTIME_HOME}
greeting = Hello, ${USER_NAME}!
price = $5 per unit
--- end ---
--- /home/eval/app/prod.env ---
# production settings
APP_ENV=prod/eu
DB_HOST=db.internal
DB_PORT=5432

DB_USER=app_rw
UNUSED_KEY=x
--- end ---

Render /home/eval/app/app.conf.tmpl into /home/eval/app/app.conf:
- `prod.env` holds `KEY=VALUE` lines; blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored. Values are taken literally (they may contain `/`).
- Every `${NAME}` placeholder whose NAME is defined in prod.env is replaced by its value.
- Placeholders whose NAME is not defined in prod.env stay exactly as written, even if a variable of that name exists in the shell environment.
- Everything else (including `$5`) is copied unchanged.

Then print one line to stdout: `unresolved: ` followed by the names of the placeholders left unresolved, sorted, unique, space-separated (here: `unresolved: RUNTIME_HOME USER_NAME`). Exit 0.

transcript.final_response:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

declare -A values=()
declare -A unresolved=()

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
    [[ -z $line || $line == \#* || $line != *=* ]] && continue

    key=${line%%=*}
    value=${line#*=}
    if [[ $key =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
        values["$key"]=$value
    fi
done < /home/eval/app/prod.env

while :; do
    line=
    if IFS= read -r line; then
        has_newline=1
    else
        has_newline=0
    fi

    [[ $has_newline -eq 0 && -z $line ]] && break

    rest=$line
    rendered=

    while [[ $rest == *'${'* ]]; do
        prefix=${rest%%'${'*}
        tail=${rest#*'${'}

        if [[ $tail != *'}'* ]]; then
            rendered+=$rest
            rest=
            break
        fi

        name=${tail%%'}'*}
        after=${tail#*'}'}
        rendered+=$prefix

        if [[ $name =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
            if [[ ${values[$name]+defined} ]]; then
                rendered+="${values[$name]}"
            else
                rendered+='${'
                rendered+=$name
                rendered+='}'
                unresolved["$name"]=1
            fi
        else
            rendered+='${'
            rendered+=$name
            rendered+='}'
        fi

        rest=$after
    done

    rendered+=$rest
    printf '%s' "$rendered"
    if [[ $has_newline -eq 1 ]]; then
        printf '\n'
    else
        break
    fi
done < /home/eval/app/app.conf.tmpl > /home/eval/app/app.conf

unresolved_names=$(printf '%s\n' "${!unresolved[@]}" | sort -u)
printf 'unresolved: %s\n' "$unresolved_names"
```
